Public Anthropic API remains ai.provider.anthropic/0.1.

Non-network acceptance:

  - batch/cost ordering and job-cost ledger unchanged
PASS test_transport_loads.rex
  - AI Access adapter constructs

PASS test_secret_broker_transport.rex
  - real-time and Batch paths acquire through SecretBroker v0.2

PASS test_alchemy_v08_adoption.rex
  - AnthropicCapabilitySelector, AnthropicProvider and AnthropicBatchProvider
    all pass Alchemy v0.8 STANDARD adoption
  - zero adoption warnings

Optional external-network probe with deliberately invalid ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:
- real-time: AI_ANTHROPIC_TRANSPORT
- Batch:     AI_ANTHROPIC_TRANSPORT
External endpoint reachability was therefore UNPROVEN in this sandbox and is
not claimed as release evidence. The deterministic fake-curl test is the
credential-boundary acceptance authority for this cut.

Scope retained:
- direct Anthropic Messages/Batch transport is implemented;
- Bedrock/Vertex routes remain selection/handoff models only; cloud-specific
  signing and transport remain outside this package.
